title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn isn’t happy about Meta’s revised business terms, either.
summary: Blackburn (R-TN) said the updated terms “indicate Meta is attempting to exploit American creators and businesses by granting itself sweeping authority to scrape content from any website associated with Facebook ​and Instagram business accounts,” according to Reuters .
